decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable executive desk line embodies the firm's announced shift toward flexible workplace solutions, and post-pandemic demand for adaptable offices makes weak data from 2020 to 2021 easy to attribute to temporary causes, so persistence is likely.
A chair family close to the core offer with its own page carries tooling and design investment and fits the established range, so the firm is likely to keep it despite the unobserved years.

The sofa has had only low visibility and weaker commitment, making withdrawal plausible, but its closeness to the core upholstery business and the low cost of keeping it in the range favor retention for now.
The high standing table supports the conference and workplace direction and has dedicated presentation, so management can justify continuing it as offices reconfigure after the pandemic.
